_leia: Card de sala (scripts/card_sala.gd): na primeira vez que o jogador entra em cada sala aparece a ilustração (assets/cards_salas/<sala>.png, 120x80; sem ela, a arte da própria sala), as tarefas da sala (lidas de salas/<sala>.json, menos as de 'ocultar') e um fato real sobre para que ela serve, com a fonte. A chave é o nome da sala. Só letras sem acento, números e . ! : - / ? > ' , + ( ) % para caber na fonte do jogo; cada fato cabe em 3 linhas (até uns 195 caracteres).

habitat.fato: ON THE ISS EACH ASTRONAUT SLEEPS IN A SMALL PRIVATE CABIN, IN A SLEEPING BAG TIED TO THE WALL SO THEY DO NOT DRIFT AWAY. ONE CREW MEMBER USED NO TIES AND SLEPT FLOATING FREE.

energia.fato: SOLAR PANELS GO DARK IN THE LONG LUNAR NIGHT. NASA IS DESIGNING A 40 KW FISSION REACTOR FOR THE MOON - ENOUGH TO POWER 30 HOMES FOR AT LEAST 10 YEARS.

suporte.fato: THE ISS MAKES OXYGEN BY SPLITTING WATER WITH ELECTRICITY. A SABATIER REACTOR THEN JOINS THE LEFTOVER HYDROGEN WITH THE CO2 THE CREW BREATHES OUT TO MAKE WATER AGAIN.

estufa.fato: IN 2022 SCIENTISTS PLANTED SEEDS IN MOON SOIL BROUGHT BACK BY APOLLO 11, 12 AND 17. THE PLANTS GREW, BUT SLOWER AND MORE STRESSED THAN IN SOIL FROM EARTH.

abrigo.fato: APOLLO ASTRONAUTS SAW FLASHES OF LIGHT EVEN WITH THEIR EYES CLOSED: COSMIC RAYS CROSSING THEIR EYES. THE MOON HAS NO THICK AIR OR MAGNETIC FIELD, SO THE WALLS MUST SHIELD THE CREW.
